title: formula: the build-time refusal of working-day functions in a field defaultValue misses fields added through objectExtensions
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a build-check gap, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7122583643). Source: the contract delta record 7122552709 on PR #36796 (Fixes #35356), item N6. It is outside that card.

## What happens

PR #36796 refuses at build an expression `defaultValue` that calls the working-day functions (`addWorkingDays`, `workingDaysBetween`, `addWorkingHours`). The refusal is `workingDayValueSiteIssues`, and it walks `stack.objects` only.

A field added through an `objectExtensions` entry with such a `defaultValue` is not refused at build. `runStackExpressionPasses` judges an extension field's `expression` in its own walk, but that walk has no `defaultValue` counterpart.

At run time the default comes out blank with a warning, the same as before. It is never a wrong value.

reach: read from the contract delta record, not measured. It reaches builders who put a working-day function in the default of an extension field, which is rare.

## Expected

The same build-time refusal for a working-day `defaultValue` on an object's own field and on a field an `objectExtensions` entry adds.

## Acceptance

- `workingDayValueSiteIssues` (or the extension walk in `runStackExpressionPasses`) also judges `objectExtensions` fields' `defaultValue`.
- A test: a working-day `defaultValue` on an extension field is refused at build with the same message as on an own field. The control: an extension field whose default does not use those functions stays green.

## Order

After PR #36796 merges. The function is not on main until then.

Blocked-by: #36796

Dedupe: open issues for `workingDayValueSiteIssues`, and for objectExtensions plus defaultValue plus working day, return none.
